## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

A six-juan music treatise in 27 chapters by the obscure mid-Míng music-theorist Ní Fù of Sìmíng 四明 (Níngbō). The book opens with the *Huángzhōng běnyuán dìngfǎ* ("Method for fixing the foundations of the *huángzhōng*") and ends with the *Fēngyǎ shí'èr shī túpǔ* ("Diagrammatic notation for twelve *Shī*-odes from the *Guófēng* and *Yǎ*"). It was completed in autumn 1526 (Jiājìng *bǐngxū*) and provided with a preface by Zhāng Bāngqí 張邦奇 in winter of the same year. Ní's working method is to anchor every doctrine in the *Yílǐ jīng zhuàn* (Zhū-Cài tradition), to compare it with Cài Yuándìng's *Lǜlǚ xīnshū* ([KR1i0003](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1i/KR1i0003)), then to cross-examine the historical institutions and the disputes of the schools. The work is competent and erudite but lacks the doctrinal force of [韓邦奇](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%9F%93%E9%82%A6%E5%A5%87)'s contemporary *Yuànluò zhì yuè* ([KR1i0007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1i/KR1i0007)).

**Abstract**

The *Zhōnglǜ tōngkǎo* is a learned but second-rank Míng synthesis of the Cài-Zhū *lǜlǚ* tradition, completed in 1526 and prefaced by the Sìmíng official Zhāng Bāngqí. Its principal interest is comparative: Ní Fù carefully sets out the disagreements between Zhū Xī and Cài Yuándìng on technical points of pitch-pipe theory and adjudicates between them, generally in favour of Cài. The Sìkù compilers note three serious failings: (1) the speculative reading of the *Lǚshì chūnqiū* "3 *cùn* 9 *fēn*" as 9-*cùn*-times-9-square-*fēn* (a mathematical-arithmetic dodge already proposed by Hé Táng and Zhū Zàiyù); (2) a politically allegorical reading of the *biàngōng* and *biànzhǐ* as Zhōu commemorations of the execution of King Zhòu and the abolition of Shāng policies; (3) failure to consult [韓邦奇](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E9%9F%93%E9%82%A6%E5%A5%87)'s contemporary *Yuànluò zhì yuè* ([KR1i0007](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR1/KR1i/KR1i0007)). Despite these the work is regarded by the compilers as the product of a serious and industrious mind, and is preserved in the SKQS in part because Míng-period writings on the technical detail of *xuángōng* and *biànshēng* are otherwise scarce. The catalog meta gives no precise date; the 1526 dating from Zhāng Bāngqí's preface is the firm bracket.
